flag_yellow.note: A yellow flag with another car as the likely cause. sector: where that car is (1-based, in the sessions' own sector count), not where the player is.

flag_double_yellow.text: Waving yellow, sector {sector}. Be ready to slow down.
flag_double_yellow.note: A waving yellow flag (danger ahead). sector: where the slow car causing it is, 1-based.

flag_yellow_cause.note: Said when the simulator shows the debris flag. cause: debris.

flag_debris.note: Said when the simulator shows the debris flag with no yellow flag out. Observed: the debris flag comes alone, as a surface flag.

flag_yellow_ahead.note: A yellow flag when no slow car could be identified near the player (no sector is made up).

flag_double_yellow_ahead.note: A waving yellow flag when no slow car could be identified near the player.

situation.off_track: off. Rejoin carefully, cars are coming
situation.stopped: stopped on track. Get going carefully

flag_yellow_self.note: The yellow flag is about the player's own car (stopped or off the track), so a short note instead of a flag call. situation: off_track or stopped. Said once per incident; the clear call is not said for it.

flag_clear.note: The yellow flag is gone for a few seconds after one was called.

flag_blue.note: A faster car a lap or more ahead is close behind. driver: its name.

flag_blue_next.note: The blue flag still holds and another faster car a lap or more ahead is now behind the player (a train of lapping cars); said only after flag_blue, for each new car. driver: its name.

flag_blue_unknown.text: Blue flag, let the faster car through.
flag_blue_unknown.note: Blue flag when the lapping car could not be identified.

final_lap.note: The race's last lap has begun.

flag_red.text: Red flag. Slow down and come back to the pits.
flag_red.note: The red flag: the session is stopped.

flag_black_orange.note: The meatball flag: the car is damaged and has to go to the pits.

retired.text: You are out of the race.
retired.note: The player's car is out of the race.

chequered.note: The player took the chequered flag. position: the finishing position. The text does not end with a full stop: in some languages the written ordinal carries its own ("20."), and a second one would double it.

chequered_no_position.note: The player took the chequered flag; the position is not known.

fcy_start.note: A full-course caution begins: the pace car is on track.

fcy_pits_open.note: During the caution the pit lane opens.

fcy_last_lap.note: The one-lap-to-green flag during a caution: the green comes at the end of this lap.

fcy_restart.note: The race restarts under green after a caution; the simulator shows the green flag itself, with no warning before it.

penalty_served.note: The drive-through or stop-and-go penalty was served.

rival_disqualified.note: Another driver was disqualified. driver: the name.

rival_out.note: Another driver retired. driver: the name.

spotter_car_left.note: A car is alongside on the player's left and the right is empty (also when a three-wide drops to the left only).

spotter_car_right.note: A car is alongside on the player's right and the left is empty (also when a three-wide drops to the right only).

spotter_in_the_middle.note: Cars on both sides of the player (three wide).

spotter_still_right.note: The car called alongside on the right is still there, repeated every 3 seconds while it holds.

spotter_still_left.note: The car called alongside on the left is still there, repeated every 3 seconds while it holds.

spotter_still_middle.note: The cars called on both sides are still there, repeated every 3 seconds while it holds.

spotter_clear_left.note: The car alongside on the left has gone.

spotter_clear_right.note: The car alongside on the right has gone.

spotter_all_clear.note: Both sides are empty again after "In the middle".

radio_check.text: Radio check from the iRacing connector.
radio_check.note: A test of the announcement path, sent by hand.

engineer_test.note: A test message for the race engineer, sent by hand. text: a free sentence.

penalty_black_flag.text: Black flag: you have a penalty. Box to serve it.
penalty_black_flag.note: The black flag is shown to the player: a penalty to serve at the pits.

incident.note: The player's incident count rose. points: the rise (merged within two seconds); total: the count now. Both are spoken as bare numbers on purpose: no noun follows, so no plural agreement is needed (and no "x" is glued to the number).

incident_limit_warning.note: The incident count is near the event's limit. total: the count; limit: the event's limit.
